summary: Oceaneering International filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $500M private placement of 6.875% Senior Notes due 2034. The offering was made to QIBs under Rule 144A and non-US persons under Regulation S. The notes are unsecured, rank equally with existing senior unsecured debt, and mature July 15, 2034. Oceaneering may redeem the notes at make-whole prices before July 15, 2029, and at descending premiums thereafter. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
